buckets.note: USP 1 History of U.S. Urban Communities, USP 2 Urban World System, or USP 6 Introduction to Global Architecture.

buckets.label: Intro to Real Estate and Development Process (required)
Applied Urban Economics (required)
buckets.note: Applied Urban Economics for Planning and Development.

buckets.note: Real Estate and Development Principles and Analysis.

buckets.note: ECON 4 / MGT 4 Financial Accounting; ECON 4/MGT 4 plus MGT 5 may be replaced with MGT 45.

buckets.label: Managerial Accounting (required)

buckets.label: Foundation core (all required)
buckets.note: USP 124 Land Use Planning; USP 150 RE&D Law and Regulation; USP 151 Real Estate Planning and Development; USP 152A RE Development Finance and Investment; USP 153 RE&D Market Analysis.

buckets.note: USP 119 Planning for Natural Hazards, USP 169 Intro to Green Building, USP 170 Planning for Sustainable Communities, USP 171 Sustainable Development, USP 171GS International Sustainable Development.

buckets.note: USP 185A Real Estate Finance and Development Studio I (Fall only) then USP 185B Studio II (Winter only). Senior year.
